text: Yes, the tree cover on this asset appears unchanged since 2020. Earth-observation data from 2021 through 2025 show no detected tree-cover loss events of 0.5 hectares or larger. The analysis used high-resolution satellite imagery (30-meter pixels) covering the entire asset, so any significant changes would likely have been visible. However, small changes below 0.5 hectares or narrow strips near the asset’s edges might have been missed. The 2020 baseline showed 43.3 hectares (11.55%) of the asset as forested, and no subsequent loss events were recorded.
